Share your views on the surprise reinstatement of its CEO Jensen Huang made his return to Nvidia’s headquarters with a hero’s welcome on Monday, hours after being reinstated as the chief executive of the world’s most valuable chip company following an intervention by Donald Trump.

headlines.headline: Jensen’s back. What does that mean for Nvidia CFO Colette Kress?
headlines.description: Good morning. Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia’s CEO . But for Colette Kress, who briefly held the top job while continuing to serve as CFO, the leadership reset doesn’t necessarily mean a return to business as usual.

sources.name: Oregon Public Broadcasting
sources.title: Who really owns the land in Albania that Jared Kushner wants to develop?
sources.description: In the summer of 2021, Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump boarded a yacht owned by Nat Rothschild, an heir to the European banking family. On the way from Montenegro to Greece, the yacht anchored off the coast of Albania. And, as Kushner told an investment conference last year, that’s when Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama arrived at the boat to tell them about his plan for the country.
